title: Testing the blast-wave AGN feedback scenario in MCG-03-58-007
question: Does the molecular gas in MCG-03-58-007 show a momentum-boosted outflow, as expected from energy-conserving blast-wave AGN feedback, given its X-ray UFO?

what.value: X-ray UFO energetics (Edot 2.4e44 erg/s, pdot 2e35, Mdot 1.5 Msun/yr)

evidence.quote: The kinetic power of the persistent component of the wind is $\dot{E}_{k1} \sim 2.4\cdot10^{44}\,\rm erg\,s^{-1}$
A star formation rate of SFR=$20.1\pm0.9\,\rm M_{\odot}~yr^{-1}$ was estimated by

what.value: alpha_CO = 3.1±2.1 average of nearby star-forming galaxies

evidence.quote: Such conversion factor is the average of the values calculated in nearby star-forming galaxies by (cite: Sandstrom2013ApJ...777....5S)
which is the value calculated by (cite: Cicone2018ApJ...863..143C) for the molecular outflow of NGC 6240

what.value: earlier redshift z=0.03220 and SEST CO frequency

evidence.quote: older redshift of $z=0.03220$ measured by (cite: Strong2004MNRAS.353.1151S)

what.value: L_CO-SFR correlation for local SF galaxies

evidence.quote: we use the $L_{CO}-SFR$ correlation computed for a sample of local SF galaxies (cite: Cicone+17)

what.value: SF wind and SN output predictions

evidence.quote: Using the theoretical predictions of the stellar winds and SNe output in the ISM (cite: Veilleux2005ARA&A..43..769V)

recipe.method: uvcontsub using line-free channels; centroid of CO PV rotation curve taken as systemic velocity

recipe.goal: Total CO spectrum and molecular gas mass
recipe.method: Multi-Gaussian fit of spectrum in a 25" aperture; Solomon formula with alpha_CO = 3.1±2.1
3D BAROLO fit of thin rotating disk with 8 rings, geometry (i, PA, centre) fixed from moment maps
assumptions: geometrically thin disk dominated by pure rotation

recipe.method: Subtract model cube; integrate residuals over (-222,-148) and (121,195) km/s; fit Gaussians to red/blue spectra

recipe.goal: Outflow energetics and comparison with X-ray UFO
recipe.method: Biconical model, tau_dyn=R/v_out, Mdot=M/tau, Pdot=Mdot v, Edot=0.5 Mdot v^2; ratios to UFO
assumptions: cone axis at 45 deg to line of sight; alpha_CO^out = 2.1 (range 0.8-3.4)

evidence.quote: we obtain a new redshift estimate of $z=0.03236\pm0.00002$
We measure a continuum flux density of $0.60\pm0.10$ mJy at $\nu_{obs}=99\,\rm GHz$.
$M_{H2}\simeq(9 \pm 6)\frac{\alpha_{CO}}{3.1} \cdot 10^9\,\rm M_{\odot}$
$S^{\rm disk}_{\rm CO}=50\pm3\,\rm Jy\,km\,s^{-1}$
This corresponds to 78$\%$ of the total molecular gas traced by the CO(1-0) emission detected by ALMA.
$i=37\pm10\,\rm deg$
$54\frac{\alpha_{CO}}{2.1}$
The ratio between the momentum rates of the two outflows is $\dot{P}_{mol}/\dot{P}_{UFO}\sim0.4$.
$\dot{E}_{mol}/\dot{E}_{UFO}\sim4\cdot10^{-3}$
SFR$(r<2\,\rm kpc) = 10 \pm 5\,\rm M_{\odot}\,yr^{-1}$
